_comment: The tamer level (0..10): how it changes and what it does. The C holds none of these numbers: a key left out means that does not exist. chance = percent per event; the sign of each event is fixed (a happy year +1; a bad year, eating poop, sleeping late, a chip item -1; evolving +1). yearHappy.happiness: a year ends with exactly that happiness; yearUnhappy.happinessBelow: ends below that. rebirth.percentPerLevel: on a natural death the new baby inherits this percent per tamer level of each old base stat. lostLife: losing a life forgets (forgetBase - level) * forgetPerLevel percent of the learned moves.
